free_text: Given the PI-RADS 5 finding and the rising PSA trend, coupled with the fact that the prior biopsy result grade was not documented, a new biopsy is indicated to establish the pathological context. The rising PSA trajectory, with a velocity of +7.47 ng/mL per year, supports the need for further tissue sampling. The evidence converged on the necessity of a biopsy to guide definitive management.
